name: g3_m4pre_ridgepc
prereg: G3 M4 pre-check (pre-registered, docs/g3_nonlinear_results.md section 1): run with --folds 0 only. GO for M4 iff the mean over model seeds 0-4 of the MLP's fold-0 P1 (variable genes) is greater than M4pre_RidgePC's fold-0 P1 (same PCs, targets and inner split). Otherwise M4 is dropped.
